CERT-EU.title: 2026-018: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP
CERT-EU.description:
On 20 October 2026, the PHP project announced an upcoming security release addressing two critical vulnerabilities in PHP. Public reports indicated that these vulnerabilities could lead to remote code execution (RCE).
The PHP team released the fixes today, 21 October 2026 at 13:30 UTC, in PHP versions 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. Both vulnerabilities can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. Technical details are now being discussed publicly, and initial proofs of concept (PoCs) have begun to circulate. This raises the likelihood that attackers are already exploiting the vulnerabilities.
[New] On 23 October, PHP disclosed a new RCE vulnerability. However, it affects only web applications configured in an unusual way, and PHP considers it an unlikely risk. PHP will not issue an out-of-band release for this vulnerability. Instead, organisations are advised to apply mitigation to fully protect from this RCE vector.
CERT-EU advises organisations to patch affected assets immediately. Where that is not feasible, organisations should consider isolating internet-facing applications from public networks until a fix is applied and verified.

CERT-EU.title: 2026-019: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
CERT-EU.description:
On 21 October 2026, GitLab published a security advisory addressing several vulnerabilities among which a critical flaw that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on a GitLab server.
CERT-EU recommends organisations to update affected assets as soon as possible, prioritising internet facing assets, and to run an assessment to identify compromised assets.

CERT-EU.title: 2026-017: Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
CERT-EU.description:
On 14 October 2026, Cisco published a security advisory addressing a critical vulnerability affecting the Advanced Malware Protection (AMP) feature of Cisco Secure Email Gateway. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files and execute commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.
The Cisco PSIRT is aware of active exploitation of this vulnerability.
CERT-EU strongly recommends updating the Content Scanner Tools package or upgrading Cisco AsyncOS Software to a fixed release as soon as possible, prioritising appliances reachable from the internet. CERT-EU also recommends checking all affected appliances for indicators of compromise.

CERT-EU.title: 2026-016: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab CE and EE
CERT-EU.description:
On 12 October 2026, GitLab released versions 19.4.2, 19.3.4 and 19.2.8 of GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE), fixing 24 security issues among which a critical vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server.
CERT-EU strongly recommends upgrading self-managed GitLab CE/EE instances to a fixed version as soon as possible, starting with internet-facing instances.

CERT-EU.title: 2026-015: Critical Vulnerability in Multiple Atlassian Products
CERT-EU.description:
On 5 October 2026, Atlassian published a security advisory addressing a critical arbitrary file access vulnerability. It affects Bitbucket Data Center, Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye.
CERT-EU strongly recommends upgrading all affected installations to a fixed version as soon as possible, starting with instances accessible from the internet. CERT-EU also recommends checking access logs for signs of exploitation.

CERT-EU.title: 2026-014: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway
CERT-EU.description:
On 27 September 2026, Citrix published a security bulletin addressing 8 vulnerabilities affecting customer-managed Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway, among which 2 critical unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerabilities. Citrix has confirmed active exploitation of these 2 critical vulnerabilities in the wild.
CERT-EU recommends updating affected software and running a compromise assessment on those exposed on the internet.

CERT-EU.title: 2026-013: Critical Vulnerability in F5 BIG-IP APM
CERT-EU.description:
On 22 September 2026, F5 published an advisory addressing a critical vulnerability affecting its BIG-IP APM product. The vendor confirmed active exploitation in the wild.
CERT-EU recommends taking appropriate actions as soon as possible.

CERT-EU.title: 2026-012: Critical Vulnerabilities in Check Point Products
CERT-EU.description:
On 9 September 2026, Check Point released emergency security updates addressing two critical vulnerabilities affecting Check Point Security Gateway, Security Management Server, and Spark Firewall deployments configured to use Remote Access VPN or Site-to-Site VPN. Both vulnerabilities carry a CVSS score of 9.8 and could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on affected appliances.
CERT-EU strongly recommends applying the available hotfixes as soon as possible, prioritising internet-facing and perimeter appliances.

CERT-EU.title: 2026-011: Critical Vulnerabilities in SAP Kernel and NetWeaver Message Server
CERT-EU.description:
On 8 September 2026, as part of its September Security Patch Day, SAP released Security Notes addressing two critical vulnerabilities affecting a broad range of SAP products[3]. The most severe, CVE-2026-44756 (CVSS 10.0), is a memory corruption vulnerability in SAP Extended Passport (EPP) processing, nicknamed "OVERPASS" by the Onapsis Research Labs (ORL), which discovered and responsibly disclosed it[3]. The second, CVE-2026-58240 (CVSS 9.8), nicknamed "S4GET", is a missing authentication check in the SAP NetWeaver Message Server[6].
Both are remotely exploitable without authentication. According to the reporting researchers, successful exploitation of either can result in arbitrary operating system command execution under the account that owns the SAP installation, leading to full compromise of the affected system and the business data it holds[6].
CERT-EU strongly recommends applying SAP Security Notes 3747649 and 3759472 as soon as possible.

CERT-EU.title: 2026-010: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
CERT-EU.description:
On 19 August 2026, Citrix published a security advisory addressing multiple critical vulnerabilities in NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway).
CERT-EU recommends updating affected devices as soon as possible.

Canadian Cyber Centre.title: AL26-028 – Ongoing Help Desk Voice Phishing Campaign Targeting Canadian Organizations
Canadian Cyber Centre.description:
Serial number: AV26-028
Date: October 28, 2026

Audience

This Alert is intended for IT professionals and managers.

Purpose

An Alert is used to raise awareness of a recently identified cyber threat that may impact cyber information assets, and to provide additional detection and mitigation advice to recipients. The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security ("Cyber Centre") is also available to provide additional assistance regarding the content of this Alert to recipients as requested.

Details

The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (Cyber Centre) is aware of an ongoing voice phishing (vishing) campaign targeting Canadian organizations, including organizations in the legal and financial sectors. Multiple Canadian firms have been targeted by individuals impersonating internal IT support and directing employees to fraudulent sign-in pages. The tradecraft and infrastructure are consistent with publicly reported operations by a financially motivated threat actor Footnote 1Footnote 2.

Throughout 2026, this activity has shifted across sectors, increasingly targeting finance and legal organizations since July Footnote 1. The Cyber Centre has identified related infrastructure naming Canadian organizations since January, with October activity concentrated on the legal sector. The campaign bypasses conventional multi-factor authentication (MFA) through real-time relay and frequently rotates lure domains, limiting the effectiveness of blocklists.

Initial Access

  • Help desk voice phishing: Callers impersonate internal IT or help desk staff and claim an urgent passkey migration, MFA enrolment or password change is required. Calls may target personal mobile phones, office phones or Microsoft Teams, and may spoof legitimate help desk numbers. Callers may reference internal IT staff or missed deadlines to add credibility and may end the call if the employee attempts independent verification Footnote 1.
  • Organisation-branded adversary-in-the-middle sign-in pages: The caller directs the employee to an organisation-branded subdomain on a generic root domain designed to mimic an enrolment portal.
    • The targeted organization’s name may appear as a subdomain of a generic domain (e.g., <org-name>.onetimesso[.]com, <org-name>.registermymfa[.]com) or be incorporated directly into a newly registered domain (e.g., <org-name>sso[.]com, <org-name>internal[.]com).
    • Domains commonly combine action words such as "activate", "enroll", "register", "create", "add", "enable", "deploy" or "set" with authentication-related terms such as "passkey", "sso", "mfa" or "2fa". Other commonly used terms include "okta", "internal", "signin", "account", "security", "portal", "setup", "connect" and "sync".
    • The page relays credentials and MFA responses to the legitimate identity provider, providing the actor with an authenticated session Footnote 1Footnote 2.

Post-Compromise Activity

After obtaining an authenticated session, the actor has been reported to Footnote 1Footnote 2:

  • Register attacker-controlled MFA methods or devices to maintain access.
  • Delete password-reset, MFA-change and security notifications, and reset passwords for non-SSO applications.
  • Use automated scripts and Microsoft Graph to access and exfiltrate data from Microsoft 365 and connected SaaS applications, including SharePoint and OneDrive.
  • Send extortion demands following data theft.

Suggested actions

The Cyber Centre recommends that organizations:

  • Deploy phishing-resistant MFA, such as FIDO2 security keys, device-bound passkeys or platform authenticators, particularly for privileged and high-risk users Footnote 3.
  • Enforce conditional access requiring managed devices and restrict sign-ins from commercial VPNs, hosting providers and residential proxies.
  • Strengthen verification for MFA resets, account recovery and new device enrolments, and reduce session lifetimesFootnote 1.
  • Monitor for suspicious MFA registrations, scripted or high-volume Microsoft 365 file access, security-email deletion and newly registered domains impersonating the organization Footnote 2.
  • Instruct employees to independently verify unexpected IT calls requesting MFA, passkey or password changes, regardless of caller ID or urgency Footnote 4.
  • Provide a clear channel for reporting suspicious calls and associated websites.
  • If compromise is suspected, revoke active sessions and tokens, reset credentials, remove unauthorized MFA methods or devices, and review mailbox and file activity.
  • Preserve relevant identity provider and Microsoft 365 audit logs for investigation Footnote 5.
  • Restrict external communications in collaboration platforms (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Webex, Slack, among others), including direct messaging, calls and meeting invitations, to trusted or operationally required external users, and regularly review guest access and permissions.

Organizations should also review the Cyber Centre’s Top 10 IT Security ActionsFootnote 6.

Should activity matching the content of this alert be discovered, recipients are encouraged to report via My Cyber Portal, or email contact@cyber.gc.ca.

Canadian Cyber Centre.title: AL26-027 - Critical vulnerability impacting Google Brotli – CVE-2026-111497
Canadian Cyber Centre.description:
Number: AL26-027
Date: October 28, 2026

Audience

This Alert is intended for IT professionals and managers.

Purpose

An Alert is used to raise awareness of a recently identified cyber threat that may impact cyber information assets, and to provide additional detection and mitigation advice to recipients. The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security ("Cyber Centre") is also available to provide additional assistance regarding the content of this Alert to recipients as requested.

Details

The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (Cyber Centre) is aware of a critical vulnerability affecting the Google Brotli compression libraryFootnote 1. In response to the vendor advisory, the Cyber Centre released an advisory on October 26, 2026Footnote 2.

Google Brotli is an open-source compression algorithm developed by Google that reduces the size of web content, such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, to improve website loading speed and reduce bandwidth usage.

Tracked as CVE-2026-111497Footnote 3, the vulnerability is an out-of-bounds write (CWE-787)Footnote 4, vulnerability affecting the Google Brotli decoder. Known as “Broccoli2Shell”Footnote 5, the vulnerability could be exploited remotely without authentication by sending specially crafted compressed data. Successful exploitation could result in memory corruption, disclosure of sensitive information, process crashes or arbitrary code execution in affected applications or services.

Because Brotli is widely integrated into other software, organizations should assess applications and products that bundle or rely on vulnerable Brotli components. Affected technologies include Node.js, Microsoft .NET, PowerShell, Bun, Envoy Proxy, Istio, and the Python Brotli and brotlicffi packages, among others.

On October 27, 2026, Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added CVE-2026–111497 to their Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) DatabaseFootnote 6.

Suggested actions

The Cyber Centre strongly recommends that organizations identify affected Brotli installations and update vulnerable components to an appropriate fixed release :

Affected Product Affected versions Fixed versions
Brotli Versions 1.0.3 prior to 1.0.10 Version 1.0.10
Brotli Versions 1.1.0 prior to 1.1.1 Version 1.1.1
Brotli Versions 1.2.0 prior to 1.2.1 Version 1.2.1

The Cyber Centre recommends that organizations:

  • Identify Internet-facing systems, applications and services that use vulnerable Brotli components and prioritize their remediation, including third-party software and dependenciesFootnote 7.
  • Apply applicable security updates as soon as possible.
  • Where immediate remediation is not feasible, prevent affected applications from processing Brotli-compressed content from untrusted sources until an update can be applied.
  • Monitor affected systems for unexpected crashes, abnormal process behaviour or other suspicious activity.

Organizations should also review the Cyber Centre’s Top 10 IT Security ActionsFootnote 8.

Should activity matching the content of this alert be discovered, recipients are encouraged to report via My Cyber Portal, or email contact@cyber.gc.ca.

Canadian Cyber Centre.title: AL26-026 - Critical vulnerabilities impacting PHP - CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 - Update 2
Canadian Cyber Centre.description:
Number: AL26-026
Date: October 21, 2026
Updated: October 27, 2026

Audience

This Alert is intended for IT professionals and managers.

Purpose

An Alert is used to raise awareness of a recently identified cyber threat that may impact cyber information assets, and to provide additional detection and mitigation advice to recipients. The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security ("Cyber Centre") is also available to provide additional assistance regarding the content of this Alert to recipients as requested.

Details

The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (Cyber Centre) is aware of critical vulnerabilities affecting PHPFootnote 1. In response to the vendor advisory, the Cyber centre released an advisory on October 21, 2026Footnote 2.

Tracked as CVE-2026-109618Footnote 3 and CVE-2026-109619Footnote 4, these vulnerabilities are Use After Free vulnerabilities (CWE-416)Footnote 5 affecting multiple versions of PHP. Known as “php2shell”Footnote 6, successful exploitation could allow an unauthenticated threat actor to execute arbitrary code on an affected system. Internet-facing PHP servers and applications are at heightened risk.

The PHP Security Team has released security updates addressing these vulnerabilities. Organizations should identify affected systems and apply the appropriate updates immediately.

PHP remains a widely deployed technology and continues to support a substantial proportion of web applications worldwide.

All PHP installations serving web requests, including PHP-FPM, Apache with mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP and LiteSpeed are at risk. PHP assess the risk as greatest for mod_php, as a demonstrated exploit allows an unauthenticated request to trigger the vulnerability before application-level code is executed.

The Cyber Centre has observed open-source reporting indicating that a Proof of Concept (PoC) is available, with no active exploitation being identified at this time, but that can change quickly.

Update 1

On October 23, 2026, the PHP Security Team published additional information regarding another remote code execution vulnerabilityFootnote 9, tracked as CVE-2026-115560Footnote 10. The vulnerability is not addressed by the security updates released on October 21, 2026.

Successful exploitation of CVE-2026-115560 requires an uncommon combination of PHP configuration and application behaviour. Applications that do not change the serialization handler at runtime are not exposed to this attack vector.

Until a security update is available, the PHP Security Team recommends disabling the session upload progress feature:
session.upload_progress.enabled=0

This mitigation was previously recommended for CVE-2026-109619. Organizations that have already applied this mitigation and kept it in place do not need to take additional action specifically for CVE-2026-115560.

Update 2

Open-source reporting indicates that CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 are being exploited in the wild.

On October 26, 2026, Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added CVE-2026-109618Footnote 11 and CVE-2026-109619Footnote 12 to their Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Database.

Suggested actions

The Cyber Centre strongly recommends that organizations running affected PHP versions upgrade to the following fixed version:

affected PHP versions upgrade
Affected Product Affected Versions Fixed Versions
PHP 8.5.x prior to 8.5.12 8.5.12
PHP 8.4.x prior to 8.4.27 8.4.27
PHP 8.3.x prior to 8.3.36 8.3.36
PHP 8.2.x prior to 8.2.35 8.2.35

Note: versions 8.1 and older no longer receive updates from the PHP project. Some distributions and LTS vendors provide backported fixes, so contact your vendor for details, or upgrade to a supported version.

The Cyber Centre recommends that organizations:

  • Update affected PHP installations immediately to a fixed, supported release.
  • Prioritize Internet-facing systems and applications that process untrusted input.
  • Identify third-party products, appliances and containers that include vulnerable PHP componentsFootnote 7.
  • Where immediate remediation is not feasible, organisations should consider isolating internet-facing applications from public networks until a fix can be applied.
  • Monitor for potential compromise by reviewing web server, application, authentication, and endpoint logs for suspicious activity.
  • Investigate unexpected processes, commands, files, accounts or outbound connections associated with PHP or web-server services.
  • Continuously monitor third-party vendors for security updates, including appliances, applications and services that bundle PHP, and apply applicable patches without delay.

Organizations should also review the Cyber Centre’s Top 10 IT Security ActionsFootnote 8.

Should activity matching the content of this alert be discovered, recipients are encouraged to report via My Cyber Portal, or email contact@cyber.gc.ca.

Canadian Cyber Centre.title: AL26-025 - Critical vulnerability impacting BeyondTrust Remote Support – CVE-2026-102764
Canadian Cyber Centre.description:
Number: AL26-025
Date: October 16, 2026

Audience

This Alert is intended for IT professionals and managers.

Purpose

An Alert is used to raise awareness of a recently identified cyber threat that may impact cyber information assets, and to provide additional detection and mitigation advice to recipients. The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security ("Cyber Centre") is also available to provide additional assistance regarding the content of this Alert to recipients as requested.

Details

The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (Cyber Centre) is aware of a critical vulnerability affecting BeyondTrust Remote Support (RS)Footnote 1Footnote 2. In response to the vendor advisory released on October 15, 2026, the Cyber Centre released AV26-1054 on October 16, 2026Footnote 3.

Tracked as CVE-2026-102764Footnote 4, this vulnerability is an Authentication Bypass by Spoofing vulnerability (CWE-290)Footnote 5 that affects all versions of BeyondTrust Remote Support.

Successful exploitation of this vulnerability may allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to exploit insufficient origin validation in internal BeyondTrust Remote Support messaging components to perform unauthorized file operations on an affected appliance without user interaction. The vulnerability requires no credentials or user action and can enable arbitrary file uploads, potentially resulting in full compromise of the appliance.

The Cyber Centre has observed open-source reporting indicating that the vulnerability is being exploited in the wildFootnote 6.

Suggested actions

The Cyber Centre strongly recommends that organizations running affected BeyondTrust Remote Support deployments upgrade to the following fixed version:

Affected product Affected versions Fixed versions
BeyondTrust Remote Support Versions 26.2.3 and prior BT26-05-RS patch for versions 24.3.1 to v26.2.3

BeyondTrust has confirmed that a patch addressing this vulnerability was applied to all Remote Support SaaS and Privileged Remote Access SaaS customers as of 9 October 2026. Organizations using these SaaS offerings do not need to take any additional action to remediate this issue.

The Cyber Centre also recommends organizations to:

  • identify BeyondTrust Remote Support deployments within their environments and determine whether they are SaaS-hosted or self-hosted
  • verify the installed Remote Support version. Systems running 26.2.3 or earlier are identified as affected by BeyondTrust
  • upgrade Remote Support installations older than 24.3.1 to a newer supported version before applying the remediation patch
  • apply the BT26-05-RS patch to affected self-hosted Remote Support deployments running versions 24.3.1 through 26.2.3
  • confirm automatic updates are enabled, where appropriate. BeyondTrust specifically advises manual patching for self-hosted instances that are not subscribed to automatic updates
  • as an additional defensive measure, review affected appliances for unexpected or unauthorized file activity, particularly when an appliance was exposed while vulnerable

In addition, the Cyber Centre strongly recommends that organizations review and implement the Cyber Centre’s Top 10 IT Security ActionsFootnote 7 with an emphasis on the following topics:

  • consolidating, monitoring, and defending Internet gateways
  • patch operating systems and applications
  • harden operating systems and applications
  • isolate web-facing applications

Should activity matching the content of this alert be discovered, recipients are encouraged to report via My Cyber Portal, or email contact@cyber.gc.ca.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-84243
CVE.report.description:
The gettext family of functions in the GNU C Library version 2.0 and later accept LANGUAGE environment variable entries that contain '/' or that are equal to "..", unless the program is setuid or setgid (AT_SECURE).  An attacker who can set LANGUAGE in the environment of a program that uses gettext can make it load a message catalog (.mo file) from an arbitrary location in the file system.  A crafted .mo file can crash the program through out-of-range offsets, or supply translations whose format directives do not match the arguments passed by the program.  That causes undefined behaviour in the printf family of functions and may allow arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the program.  The safety of message catalogs relies on them being installed in trusted, read-only locations, and the directory traversal bypasses this.

The fix for CVE-2014-0475 rejects ".." path components in locale names passed to setlocale or taken from the LC_ALL, LC_* and LANG environment variables.  gettext reads LANGUAGE directly and appends each colon-separated entry to the message catalog directory, so that fix did not cover LANGUAGE.

LANGUAGE is only used when the LC_MESSAGES locale is not "C", "C.<encoding>" or "POSIX", so the attacker must also be able to select another installed locale, for example through LANG or LC_ALL.  Exploitation also requires that the attacker can place the crafted file in a location readable by the target program, and that the environment crosses a trust boundary without the program running as AT_SECURE.  An example is an SSH server that accepts LANGUAGE and LANG from clients through the AcceptEnv directive and restricts an account to a forced command; the attacker may use this to escape the restriction.

CVE.report.description: Memory corruption in Dawn in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-119263
CVE.report.description: Memory corruption in GarbageCollection in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-119262
CVE.report.description: Improper input validation in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-118384
CVE.report.description: GNU mtools through 4.0.49 has an out-of-bounds write in parse_vses in vfat.c.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-111357
CVE.report.description: Ivanti Connect Secure 22.8R2.4 mishandles the manner in which the dsinvoked broker trusts DSCache configuration data, leading to privilege escalation to root, as exploited in the wild in October 2026.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-101682
CVE.report.description: Vulnerability in the Applications DBA product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: AD Utilities).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with logon to the infrastructure where Applications DBA executes to compromise Applications DBA.  Successful attacks require human interaction from a person other than the attacker. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Applications DBA. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-87356
CVE.report.description: Vulnerability in the Applications Platform Engineering product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Valid Session).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with logon to the infrastructure where Applications Platform Engineering executes to compromise Applications Platform Engineering.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Applications Platform Engineering. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-62147
CVE.report.description: The Tempo Operator's gateway component failed to consistently apply namespace-scoped redaction on some query API response paths when query RBAC was enabled, allowing an authenticated user to read span attributes belonging to other tenants' namespaces.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2025-5278
CVE.report.description: A flaw was found in GNU Coreutils. The sort utility's begfield() function is vulnerable to a heap buffer under-read. The program may access memory outside the allocated buffer if a user runs a crafted command using the traditional key format. A malicious input could lead to a crash or leak sensitive data.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116900
CVE.report.description: REDAXO before 5.21.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows content editors to inject HTML by storing unescaped values rendered by media, medialist, link and linklist widgets. Attackers can submit crafted REX_INPUT_MEDIA or REX_INPUT_LINK values that break out of the value attribute, executing script in administrators' backend sessions to hijack accounts.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116896
CVE.report.description: REDAXO before 5.21.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the backup addon export that accepts any database table, allowing non-admin users with the backup[export] permission to export rex_user, rex_user_session, and other applications' tables. Attackers can obtain plaintext session ids and stay-logged-in keys to take over admin accounts, or password hashes for offline cracking.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116892
CVE.report.description: SemanticMediaWiki from 3.1.0 before 7.3.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject markup through the search parameter of the extended Special:Search profile. Attackers can send visitors crafted URLs using the smw profile with SVG event handlers, which ProfileForm::profile_sheet inserts unescaped into a pre element, executing script in the wiki origin.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116888
CVE.report.description: SemanticMediaWiki from 3.2.0 before 7.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with the smw-schemaedit right to inject markup through an unescaped property group schema canonical_name. Attackers can save a schema whose canonical_name holds script markup, which GroupFormatter renders unescaped in Special:Browse headings, executing JavaScript in viewers' sessions including administrators.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116884
CVE.report.description: SemanticMediaWiki from 5.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ext.smw.tooltip.tippy.js that renders data-* attributes via innerHTML with allowHTML enabled. Editors can plant a .smw-highlighter span with a malicious data-content, data-title, data-top, data-bottom, or data-theme attribute to execute JavaScript when viewers, including administrators, hover it.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116880
CVE.report.description: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in Special:SMWAdmin because it overwrites the wpEditToken with a freshly generated valid token. Attackers can lure an authenticated smw-admin user to a malicious page that triggers schema setup, entity-disposal, or job actions, causing semantic data loss and resource exhaustion.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116876
CVE.report.description: Semantic MediaWiki from 2.5.0 before 7.3.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows ordinary editors to permanently protect pages by adding an Is edit protected annotation. When $smwgEditProtectionRight is enabled, EditProtectionUpdater applies indefinite edit and move restrictions without checking the author's rights, locking other editors and administrators out.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116872
CVE.report.description: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in TermParser::normalize_compact_form() that allows unauthenticated attackers to cause quadratic CPU consumption. Attackers can submit long search terms with many distinct in:(...) or has:(...) expressions to Special:Search to exhaust PHP search workers when the extended search engine is enabled.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-78845
CVE.report.description: Aidot products Linkind Matter Smart Plug 1.01.32, OREiN Matter Smart Light Bulb 3.15.21, and Linkind Wi-Fi Smart Light Bulb 3.30.17 are vulnerable to Remote Code Execution (RCE) via UPnP root description parsing.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116842
CVE.report.description: DevilutionX 1.4.0 through 1.5.5 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the bundled libmpq libmpq__archive_dup routine when opening crafted MPQ archives. Attackers can supply an MPQ archive whose block table count exceeds its hash table count, causing memcpy to overflow the heap during startup and crash the game.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116828
CVE.report.description: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a sql injection vulnerability in despam.php where the from parameter is escaped but placed in an unquoted INTERVAL position. Authenticated administrators can inject SQL via the from POST parameter to perform blind reads of the database including user password hashes.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116824
CVE.report.description: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in handlers/page/referrers_sites.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via crafted Referer headers. Attackers can send a Referer hostname containing HTML metacharacters that renders unescaped, executing JavaScript for any referrer-sites page visitor to perform same-origin authenticated actions.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116820
CVE.report.description: YesWiki from 4.6.0 before 4.7.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view assembled SQL queries by adding the showreq parameter. Attackers can append showreq to public Bazar listing API requests to obtain table names, JSON storage paths, ACL filter logic, and collation, aiding targeted SQL injection.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116816
CVE.report.description: llama.cpp b5899 before b10261 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in llm_tokenizer_plamo2::build that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted GGUF models. Attackers can supply BYTE-typed token text like <0x-1> whose negative parsed value writes token ids before the bytes_ buffer during model loading, causing crashes or potential code execution.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116815
CVE.report.description: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an improper escaping vulnerability in sankey.service.ts that allows authenticated project members to break ClickHouse string literals by supplying backslashes in event names. Attackers with read access can submit crafted events[].name values to the chart.sankey procedure, causing ClickHouse parse errors that disable the project's Sankey chart endpoint.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116811
CVE.report.description: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability in the js-runtime validator that allows a project member to bypass the AST allowlist by aliasing the Function constructor. Attackers with write access can read payload.constructor.constructor into a local and call it to run arbitrary code in the worker process.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116807
CVE.report.description: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass tenant scoping by injecting unescaped profile filter names into a JOIN subquery. Attackers can supply a crafted filter name with a trailing comment to bypass the project_id WHERE clause and read events from all projects.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116803
CVE.report.description: DOMPurify before 3.4.17 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to keep event handlers armed when an IN_PLACE hook removes a parent or sibling node. Attacker markup in detached subtrees is never walked or neutralized, so handlers like img onerror fire after sanitize() returns, causing DOM XSS.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116748
CVE.report.description: Transmission 4.0.0 before 4.1.3 contains a permissive CORS vulnerability in handle_request() in rpc-server.cc that exposes the X-Transmission-Session-Id anti-CSRF token to any web origin. Malicious web pages can read the token from the 409 handshake response and replay it to issue RPC calls, enabling script-torrent-done execution, download-dir changes, or torrent and data deletion.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116744
CVE.report.description: ntop nDPI through 6.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissect_softether_host_fqdn() in softether.c that compares host_name using the consumed byte count instead of data length. Remote attackers can send crafted short UDP datagrams on already-classified SoftEther flows, causing strncmp to read beyond the packet payload buffer.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116623
CVE.report.description: A vulnerability was detected in code-projects Simple Content Management System 1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /web/admin/welcome.php of the component Admin Interface. The manipulation of the argument addnews results in missing authorization. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116605
CVE.report.description: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file order.php. The manipulation of the argument price/title results in client-side enforcement of server-side security. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116602
CVE.report.description: A vulnerability was detected in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. This issue affects the function unlink of the file admin/delete.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument image_name results in path traversal. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116554
CVE.report.description: A flaw has been found in Argilla up to 2.8.0. The affected element is the function Dataset.from_disk of the file argilla-frontend/components/features/annotation/settings/SettingsInfo.vue of the component Settings Page. Executing a manipulation of the argument Name can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116740
CVE.report.description: libcss through 0.9.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in mq_parse_media_query() that allows remote attackers to crash consumers by supplying media lists ending in a comma. Attackers can serve a stylesheet whose @media or @import media list has a trailing comma, causing NetSurf or other parsers to crash.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116755
CVE.report.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection') in the Orchestrator component of SoftIron HyperCloud allows an authenticated user with access to the management plane to execute arbitrary operating system commands on hypervisor hosts as the privileged orchestration user. Attacker-controlled virtual machine template content (for example, the VM DESCRIPTION field) is delivered to hosts through a shell here-document whose terminator is not quoted, so shell expansion and here-document terminator injection are performed on that content during virtual machine lifecycle operations such as deploy, migrate, and network setup. Exploitation requires valid credentials, access to the management plane (owning a virtual machine alone is not sufficient), and a lifecycle operation that reaches the affected host. This issue affects the Orchestrator component of SoftIron HyperCloud from 1.0 through 2.6.17 and is fixed in 2.6.18.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116736
CVE.report.description: Libpff through 20260926 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libpff_table_read_values_array because a 7c column definition's values_array_size is not checked against remaining buffer bytes. Attackers can supply a crafted PST, OST or PAB file to make applications read adjacent heap memory into record entry values or crash.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116732
CVE.report.description: libdwarf through 2.3.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dwarf_debug_addr_table() that omits the table starting offset when validating .debug_addr unit length. Attackers can supply a crafted object file with a non-zero offset table, causing dwarf_debug_addr_by_index() to read past the heap buffer, disclosing adjacent heap bytes or crashing consumers.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116728
CVE.report.description: libfvde through 20260923 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libfvde_encrypted_metadata_read_type_0x0024() because xml_plist_data_size is not checked against the source metadata block. Attackers can supply a crafted FileVault 2 Core Storage volume that makes libfvde_volume_open() copy past the heap block buffer, crashing the application.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116724
CVE.report.description: FLTK through 1.4.5 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in Fl_BMP_Image::load_bmp_() that causes undersized pixel buffer allocation from file-supplied width and height. Attackers can supply a crafted BMP or ICO file with large dimensions so row decoding writes file-derived data past the heap buffer, corrupting the application heap.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116589
CVE.report.description: Datadog dd-trace-py is the Datadog Python APM client. From 3.13.0 until 4.15.5, the IAST string-processing instrumentation does not properly handle certain internal errors while old-style % string formatting processes attacker-controlled input. An unhandled error can terminate the Python process and interrupt the work it is handling. Exploitation requires IAST to be enabled, which is not the default, and application code to apply the affected formatting operation to attacker-controlled input. This issue is fixed in version 4.15.5.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116585
CVE.report.description: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of standards in Go, including support for JSON Web Encryption (JWE), JSON Web Signature (JWS), and JSON Web Token (JWT) standards. Prior to 4.1.5, decrypting untrusted JWE ciphertext with A128CBC-HS256, A192CBC-HS384, or A256CBC-HS512 can pass an empty ciphertext buffer to CBC-HMAC unpadding. Insufficient validation allows the empty buffer to be indexed, causing a panic and denial of service. Applications that decrypt attacker-controlled ciphertext with one of these content-encryption algorithms are affected. This issue is fixed in version 4.1.5.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116581
CVE.report.description: Seroval facilitates JavaScript value stringification, including complex structures beyond JSON.stringify capabilities. Prior to 1.6.8, fromJSON and fromCrossJSON do not validate a sequence node's done index. A crafted done index can create an iterator that never finishes when application code consumes it to completion. An unauthenticated request to a service that deserializes untrusted input can therefore block the event loop, exhaust process memory, or make the service unavailable. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.8.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116577
CVE.report.description: Tornado is a Python web framework and asynchronous networking library. Prior to 6.6, Tornado's HTTP header parser accepts obsolete line folding and repeatedly concatenates short continuation lines, causing quadratic CPU consumption on the IOLoop thread. An unauthenticated client can submit a header block containing many obsolete line-folding continuations before application code runs, blocking other connections served by the process. The cost grows with max_header_size, and only availability is affected. This issue is fixed in version 6.6.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116542
CVE.report.description: Netty netty-tcnative before 2.0.84.Final contains an SNI hostname spoofing vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated clients to alter hostnames via JNI NewStringUTF decoding. Attackers can send overlong encodings like 0xC0 0x80 in the ClientHello server_name to confuse SNI-based certificate selection, access decisions, and logging.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116538
CVE.report.description: HtmlSanitizer before 9.2.1039 and 10.0 prereleases before 10.0.1037-beta contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability because SanitizeDom(string) never sanitizes attributes on the html and body wrapper elements. Attackers can supply input with a second body or html tag carrying event handlers like onload, executing script when applications render serialized document or body outer HTML.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116508
CVE.report.description: A security flaw has been discovered in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected by this issue is the function sub_402340 of the file infostat.cgi of the component Device-Information CGI. Performing a manipulation of the argument CONTENT_LENGTH results in stack-based buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116505
CVE.report.description: A vulnerability was found in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. This impacts the function getDeviceInfo of the file /var/lib/misc/udhcpd.leases of the component device-information Handler. The manipulation of the argument MAC address results in command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116482
CVE.report.description: A vulnerability has been found in subhajitkhan online-clinic-management-system up to e9ee77a8827a1446220fa07ee693dc4d9a29a578. Affected is an unknown function of the file patientregistration.php. Such manipulation of the argument pat_name leads to cross site scripting. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. This product does not use versioning. This is why information about affected and unaffected releases are unavailable. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116477
CVE.report.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in a2aproject a2a-dotnet up to 1.0.0-preview2. The impacted element is the function A2AJsonRpcProcessor.ProcessRequestAsync of the file src/A2A.AspNetCore/A2AJsonRpcProcessor.cs of the component Parser. The manipulation leads to information exposure through error message. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 1.0.0-preview3 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is ccbd12b6108a6a8f0fd5d8b4a9ece3c8a94ba1e4. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116471
CVE.report.description: A security flaw has been discovered in BKWLD Decoy up to 5.11.1. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file Policy.php of the component Authorization Policy. The manipulation of the argument role results in improper privilege management. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116461
CVE.report.description: A vulnerability was determined in Omega Solution Restro POS up to 20261026. This impacts an unknown function of the file /sale-invoice/. Executing a manipulation of the argument productUnitSalePrice can lead to business logic errors. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116369
CVE.report.description: A vulnerability was identified in Sunwood-ai-labs github-kanban-mcp-server up to 0.4.0. Impacted is the function handleListIssues of the file src/handlers/issue-handlers.ts. Such manipulation of the argument state/labels leads to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 0.4.1 is recommended to address this issue. The name of the patch is 253d93bbdf7ee9fe42bd8fdf15feea93ae59cbae. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-115924
CVE.report.description: Rembg is a tool to remove images background. Prior to 2.0.82, the public /api/remove endpoint passes attacker-controlled extras.sam_model through rembg/commands/s_command.py to rembg/sessions/sam.py, where it is interpolated into SAM filenames and GitHub download URLs passed to pooch.retrieve() without a pinned hash. An unauthenticated attacker can supply a sam_model value combining path traversal with URL fragment syntax to exploit the HTTP request discarding the fragment while the local POSIX path retains it. The first request primes the attacker-selected path tree, and an identical repeated request downloads malicious ONNX encoder and decoder files beside a readable target file. The graphs can load the target through ONNX external data and encode its bytes into the returned PNG mask, disclosing complete files accessible to the rembg process and allowing arbitrary ONNX computation. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.82.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-115921
CVE.report.description: Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard for machine learning interoperability. From 1.4.0 until 1.22.0, ScanInferenceFunction, ScanInferenceFunction_opset8, and ScanInferenceFunction_opset9 do not safely validate the required num_scan_inputs attribute. A missing attribute is dereferenced as a null pointer, while a negative value is converted to size_t and can reach an exceptional oversized allocation path. An untrusted model can therefore terminate or disrupt shape inference, including a negative-value model that can pass onnx.checker.check_model(). This issue is fixed in version 1.22.0.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-115917
CVE.report.description: vLLM is an inference and serving engine for large language models. Prior to 0.32.0, the OpenAI-compatible server configures Starlette CORSMiddleware with allowed_origins set to a wildcard by default. A malicious web page can use a victim's browser to reach an unauthenticated vLLM server on localhost, an internal network, or a VPN, call endpoints including GET /v1/models and POST /v1/chat/completions, consume GPU resources, and read responses. Cookie-based cross-site request forgery does not apply because credentials are disabled by default, and deployments requiring bearer authentication are exposed only when the caller already has a usable token. This issue is fixed in version 0.32.0.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-115910
CVE.report.description: Python Social Auth is a social authentication and registration mechanism. Prior to 6.2.0, OpenIdConnectAuth in social_core/backends/open_id_connect.py uses get_and_store_nonce to place the OpenID Connect nonce in a shared OpenIdConnectAssociation table, and get_nonce and validate_claims verify only that the nonce exists and has not expired rather than binding it to the browser session and OAuth state that initiated the login. An attacker who obtains a victim's unused authorization code can start a separate login to obtain valid state for the attacker's browser, submit the victim's code with that state, and pass nonce validation because the victim nonce is globally available. With DEFAULT_USE_PKCE disabled in the default OpenIdConnectAuth configuration, the attacker can be logged in as the victim. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.0.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-115906
CVE.report.description: zip is a zip library for Rust that supports reading and writing simple ZIP files. From 0.6.0 until 9.0.0, the AES entry reader in src/aes.rs verifies its HMAC only when the attacker-controlled data counter reaches zero. If the underlying bounded reader reaches the real end of the archive while data_remaining is still positive, or if an encrypted entry has no payload, the reader can return a clean end of stream without reading and comparing the authentication tag. Applications using by_index_decrypt, by_name_decrypt, by_path_decrypt, or password-enabled by_index_with_options can therefore accept modified plaintext without an authentication error. This issue is fixed in version 9.0.0.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-102649
CVE.report.description: Burrito is a Terraform Automation Collaboration Software (TACoS) Kubernetes operator. Prior to 0.13.0, `POST /api/webhook` accepts unsigned GitHub and GitLab events when a `TerraformRepository`'s credentials omit `webhookSecret` or set it to an empty value, including credentials configured for git authentication and polling. `Credential.WebhookSecret` is optional, and `go-playground/webhooks` skips signature or token verification when the secret is empty. Anyone who can reach `burrito-server`'s endpoint and knows a tracked repository's URL can forge events to create or delete `TerraformPullRequest` custom resources with attacker-chosen `Branch`, `Base`, and `ID` fields. For GitHub `pull_request` events, the controller fetches changed files using the real pull request number but does not cross-check the payload's branch against that pull request. Pairing a real, existing pull request number with an unrelated existing branch in the same repository can therefore cause an unauthorized `terraform plan` for affected layers using the operator's stored git and cloud credentials. Code analysis also indicates that the resulting plan can be posted to the real pull request's comment thread, exposing and misattributing another branch's infrastructure changes. Auto-apply is disabled for these temporary layers, so this vulnerability alone cannot force a `terraform apply`; plan-time provider and data-source code execution depends on the selected branch's contents. This issue is fixed in version 0.13.0.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-57193
CVE.report.description: Asterisk is an open source private branch exchange and telephony toolkit. Prior to Asterisk 20.20.1, 21.12.3, 22.10.1, 23.4.1 and Certified Asterisk 20.7-cert11, 22.8-cert3, the LDAP realtime driver `res_config_ldap` may permit `LDAP filter injection` through a `SIP username`, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to make arbitrary LDAP queries using carefully crafted SIP packets and disclose information. The `res_config_ldap` module must be loaded and configured to access an LDAP server, which is not the default. This issue is fixed in Asterisk 20.20.1, 21.12.3, 22.10.1, 23.4.1 and Certified Asterisk 20.7-cert11, 22.8-cert3.

CVE.report.title: CVE-2013-10077
CVE.report.description: A weakness has been identified in OctoPrint 1.0.0. This impacts the function getSettings of the file src/octoprint/server/ajax/settings.py of the component API Key Handler. This manipulation causes information disclosure. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 1.1.0-rc1 will fix this issue. Patch name: eccc9d6fbde0c46cdd6e255fd5ce9a30077ba954. You should upgrade the affected component. Affected is a 2013 release where access control was not yet implemented and the endpoint was part of first-run setup). CVE.report.title: CVE-2026-116215
